title: Enterprise Platform Architect DevOps
description:
**Join our Team**
-----------------

**About this opportunity**

Join our team as an Architect – AI and DevOps, helping define and deliver secure, scalable and cost-effective AI solutions for enterprise environments. You will shape architectural standards and guide the adoption of Generative AI, large language models, intelligent agents and automation across technology platforms and delivery processes.

Working with engineering, product, security and platform teams, you will connect strategic goals with practical solutions that are reliable, maintainable and ready for production.

**What you will do**

Define end-to-end AI and machine learning architectures that meet requirements for performance, availability, security, scalability and cost.  
Design enterprise solutions using large language models, prompt engineering, model tuning, efficient model deployment and secure integration.  
Consulting & Business Generation: Work with Customer Units to propose Automation and AI Solutions & capabilities in the Telecom Service Domain. Contribute to creation of End to end solution, presales estimates and work on Statement of Work and compliance document.  
Architect knowledge solutions using Retrieval-Augmented Generation, embeddings, vector databases and semantic search.  
Design intelligent agents, tool integrations and workflow orchestration using APIs and the Model Context Protocol.  
Establish standards for automated delivery pipelines covering source control, testing, security checks, artifact management, deployment and validation.  
Design cloud-native solutions using AWS, Azure or Google Cloud, Docker, Kubernetes and microservices.  
Guide infrastructure automation, configuration management and Infrastructure as Code using Ansible and related tools.  
Embed privacy, access control, security, compliance and responsible AI practices, including human approval where appropriate.  
Promote effective monitoring, logging, performance improvement and production troubleshooting.  
Communicate architectural decisions clearly and support teams in delivering consistent, high-quality solutions.

**You will bring**

Experience designing and implementing enterprise AI, machine learning, cloud or DevOps solutions.  
Strong understanding of AI and machine learning architecture, deep learning, large language models and modern AI applications.  
Proficiency in Python and practical experience with PyTorch or TensorFlow.  
Experience with prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, embeddings, vector databases, model integration and performance optimization.  
Knowledge of AI agent frameworks, workflow orchestration, tool calling, API integration and the Model Context Protocol.  
Hands-on experience with Git, Ansible, CI/CD design, Python or Bash scripting, JSON and YAML. GitLab experience is an advantage.  
Familiarity with code quality and security tools, artifact repositories and container registries.  
Experience with AWS, Azure or Google Cloud, Docker, Kubernetes, microservices, networking and identity management.  
Knowledge of Ubuntu and Red Hat Enterprise Linux environments, monitoring, logging, observability and production support.  
Strong communication, collaboration and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work across technical and business teams.

**“All academic credentials must be from recognized and accredited institutions and are further subject to verification.”**

title: Salesforce Devops
description:
CXCRM Recruitment

Dear Candidate  
Greetings from Cognizant!!

**Job Title:** Salesforce DevOps Developer

**Experience:** 4 to 12 years

**Location:** All CTS Location (3 days office, Hybrid mode)

**Notice Period:** Immediate to 90 days

#### **Job Summary**

We are looking for a skilled **Salesforce DevOps Developer** with strong Salesforce development expertise and hands-on experience in DevOps, CI/CD, version control, and release management. The ideal candidate will be responsible for automating deployments, streamlining development processes, and ensuring high-quality Salesforce releases across environments.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Design and implement Salesforce DevOps and CI/CD pipelines.
* Develop and customize Salesforce applications using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and Salesforce APIs.
* Manage source code repositories using Git, GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket.
* Automate deployments using Salesforce DX (SFDX), Copado, Gearset, AutoRABIT, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps.
* Perform code reviews and enforce development best practices.
* Manage branching, merging, release strategies, and environment synchronization.
* Work closely with developers, QA teams, and business stakeholders to ensure smooth releases.
* Troubleshoot deployment issues and optimize release processes.
* Implement security, compliance, and governance standards across Salesforce environments.
* Support Agile development and DevOps transformation initiatives.
